phase_0.boundary_condition: the system of four Pythagorean equations defining a rectangular box with all integer distances

VINIT.justification: void state before any integer constraints are applied; raw idea of a rectangular cuboid

TANCH.justification: anchor that closes the system: all three edges, three face diagonals, and space diagonal must be integers

AFWD.justification: forward morphism from edges (a,b,c) to face diagonals sqrt(a^2+b^2), sqrt(a^2+c^2), sqrt(b^2+c^2)

AREV.justification: contravariant morphism from diagonal constraints back to conditions on edges; parity flip for impossibility arguments

CLINK.justification: sequential chaining: edges→face diagonals→space diagonal constraint; the full pipeline

IMSCRIB.justification: self-referential identity: the problem itself, defined by its own constraints

FSPLIT.justification: splits the perfect cuboid problem into two branches: existence (true) and non-existence (false)

FFUSE.justification: fuses the two branches back to the original problem statement; the problem is unchanged by the decision

EVALT.justification: affirmative evaluation: a perfect cuboid is found, all distances integer

EVALF.justification: negative evaluation: a perfect cuboid is impossible, contradiction derived

ENGAGR.justification: paradice state: both existence and non-existence are held simultaneously as unresolved possibilities, representing the open problem

IFIX.justification: permanent fixation of the perfect cuboid problem as an unsolved conjecture; each proof attempt is appended immutably

phase_3.void_description: no cuboid considered; no constraints applied
phase_3.both_description: existence is unknown; both possibilities are present

steps.domain_action: define the perfect cuboid as the object of study
split on existence of a perfect cuboid
on T-arm, generate candidate edge triple via forward Pythagorean morphism
evaluate candidate as successfully satisfying all constraints
on F-arm, derive contradiction from diagonal constraints via reverse decomposition
fuse branches back to the original problem
enter paradice state; both possibilities held unresolved
permanently record the perfect cuboid problem as an open question

phase_5.compiler_frontend: logical deduction: translates the perfect cuboid constraints into a system of Diophantine equations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: equational reasoning: transmits substitutions and algebraic transformations between subproblems
phase_5.memory_mechanism: mathematical memory: stores candidate triples and proof states for retrieval
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: proof search: determines order of candidate generation and elimination
phase_5.alfs_store: Diophantine axioms: bootstrap store containing the integer ring, Pythagorean theorem, and basic number theory

phase_6.post_cycle_state: perfect cuboid problem statement with appended record of consideration
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — logical deductions are reversible and information-conservative; no entropy is generated
